Noah.title: Noah
Noah.question: Will faithful care persist through long preparation, crisis, and waiting?

chapters.title: The Blueprint
chapters.game: Measure the hull to the given proportions.

chapters.title: The Long Build
chapters.game: Gather timber, fit planks, and seal with pitch.

chapters.title: The Gathering
chapters.game: Pair animals and stock each pen.

chapters.title: The Door Shuts
chapters.game: Finish the final checks and surrender control.

chapters.title: Forty Days
chapters.game: Feed, calm, and clean animal pens during the storm.

chapters.title: The Long Wait
chapters.game: Send raven and doves at the right intervals.

chapters.title: The Covenant
chapters.game: Build the altar and reveal the rainbow.

chapters.title: The Vineyard
chapters.game: Witness Noah’s failure and choose how the sons respond.
